title.narrative: Provision of Integrated WASH Interventions in the hard-to-reach areas of Alkurmuk- Blue Nile Region.

description.narrative: ltpgtltbrgtThe proposed project directly aligns with the strategic objectives of the Sudan Humanitarian Response Plan (HRP) for 2023, specifically addressing objectives one and three. These objectives focus on alleviating the urgent needs of conflict-affected populations and enhancing access to essential services.ltbrgtThis project aims to respond to the acute WASH needs of displaced and host communities in Kurmuk (Yabus, Chali Wadaka) locality, which have suffered severely due to the ongoing conflict between the Sudan Armed Forces (SAF) and the Rapid Support Forces (RSF). As a result of this conflict, there has been substantial displacement, leading to heightened vulnerability among these populations. The project is designed to save lives and provide critical services to approximately 34,500 individuals, including 9,400 men, 9,700 women, 7,400 boys, and 8,000 girls, with a special Target Beneficiaries: Displaced individuals and host communities Kurmuk.ltbrgtSpecial attention to vulnerable groups, including people with disabilities.ltbrgtEmergency WASH Response Interventions: The project will implement various interventions to ensure access to clean water, promote optimal hygiene practices, and improve sanitation facilities. Key activities include:ltbrgtRehabilitation and Installation of Water Infrastructure:ltbrgtRehabilitation of 17 hand pumps to serving 7,500 people.ltbrgtDrilling and installation of 4 new hand pumps serving 2,000 people in Yabus, Chali, and Wadaga payams.ltbrgtRehabilitation of 2 solar-powered water yards for human, animal, and vegetable irrigation to serving 10,000 people.ltbrgtConduct water monitoring and chlorination to serve 15,000 people.ltbrgtCapacity Building and Training:ltbrgtTraining of 13 water management committees and pump mechanics, with 10 participants per committee over six days.ltbrgtProvision of 10 India M2 HP repair tool kits.ltbrgtCommunity Engagement and Hygiene Promotion:ltbrgtConduct hygiene promoter training for 5 groups (20 members each, balanced gender representation).ltbrgtImplement 6 hygiene and sanitation awareness campaigns in each target community.ltbrgtEstablishment of 3 school hygiene clubs and construction of 3 handwashing facilities.ltbrgtDistribution of dignity kits for 300 students.ltbrgtProvision of cleaning tool sets and printing of WASH IEC materials.ltbrgtOrganize 9 clean-up campaigns to foster community participation.ltbrgtThese comprehensive WASH interventions will not only provide immediate relief but also empower communities to manage their water resources sustainably, ultimately improving overall public health and resilience in the face of ongoing challenges.ltbrgtlt/pgt
